nodes.label: OKLCH palette composition strategy (5-role: bg/surface/ink/accent/muted)
nodes.rationale: 4-color frozen palettes drift to safe defaults regardless of brief; a single OKLCH seed + model-composed 5-role palette (bg, surface, ink, accent, muted) lets the same seed serve very different moods. Seed approach won mood-fit in 3/5 empirical cases vs curated 4-color palettes and tied on the rest.
